scope: Mac host and Pixel 6a shell process via temporary USB reverse forwarding
test_identities: public deterministic fixtures; not secure production keys
initial_attempt: server exited immediately after response flush; client reported connection closed before receiving response
successful_attempt: server remained running until client closed after receiving response
limitations: One exchange via USB forwarding, not wireless or two phones
No Android app integration, persistent identity, pairing, revocation or recovery
No app-level replay defense, conflict handling or storage encryption
Waiting for connection close is not a reliable receipt or retry protocol
